label: PF Backlog 86
title: Backend: per-project git repo management (connect/create, provider/remote/branch model) + status API
body: git automation exists (core/vcs.py: feature branch per implementation stage, commit/push/merge->develop, RC tag on Deploy, release merge+tag on 10a gated by Go/No-Go; core/git_manager.py worktrees) but there is NO per-project repo CONNECT/CONFIG requirement and no API to view status. Add: write project.json['vcs'] (provider/remote/branch_model/base/protected/release, sign_tags) at project creation; API GET repo status (branch, dirty, ahead/behind, conflicts) + POST connect/init; surface in the dashboard (BI-0064).
